docs.title: Site 0
docs.text:
The internal site is located at: Internal

s25-25:/opt/apan-wjc.github.io

The following command can bring it up:

ssh 192.168.56.25   # s25-25
cd /opt/apan-wjc.github.io

source venv/bin/activate
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000   # bring up a live site, any change shows lively.

deactivate

docs.title: Setup
docs.text:
cd /opt/apan-wjc.github.io
\rm -rf venv   # if venv already exists and need to redo

source venv/bin/activate
pip --version
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install mkdocs
pip install mkdocs-material
mkdocs --version
mkdocs new .   # ONLY for the first time
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000

docs.title: Publish
docs.text:
After all change looks good, the following command will launch a deployment and update the site

cd /opt/apan-wjc.github.io

git status
git diff

mkdocs build

git add -A && git commit -a -m "XXXXXXXXX"
git push

mkdocs gh-deploy
or
mkdocs gh-deploy --force

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: MkDocs
docs.text:
1. Using command mkdocs gh-deploy will deploy main to branch gh-pages, built-in command mkdocs build
  2. CNAME in the main root should be copied to site/, in order to make customized domain work.
  3. CNAME wjc.ox0.ca to apan-wjc.github.io should be set in DNS beforehand.

docs.title: SSH config for GitHub
docs.text:
1. Log in to Github.
  2. Go User/Settings
  3. Generate key pair with ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -a 100 -C "your-email@example.com" -f /opt/key/apan-wjc
  4. Add public key at Github.

  5. Add these to ~/.ssh/config

    Host github-apan-wjc
    HostName github.com
    User git
    IdentityFile /opt/key/apan-wjc
    IdentitiesOnly yes

  6. Add these to file .envrc in the root directory of the repo

    #!/bin/bash

git config user.email "your-email@example.com"
git config user.name "alex-wjc"

git remote set-url origin git@github-apan-wjc:apan-wjc/apan-wjc.github.io.git

  7. Run source .envrc whenever you enter this place, or use direnv do so automatically.

  8. Test it to verify the result
    ssh -T git@github-apan-wjc
Hi apan-wjc! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.
